name: Harmony 650, two devices composed in one write
description: todo-compile-650 2.7, one write of lab/work/bench-2-7/h650-two-devices.bin: the Panasonic TX-29AK40F as 'Pana' and the Knoll HDP-1100 as 'Knoll', composed in one run onto the 650's own configuration (h650_panasonic_config), section 331. Neither device is in an activity, so only their own pages send their codes. Keep the remote pointed at the Flirc. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow; the four buttons beside the screen each choose the label in the corner next to them.

steps.instruction: Start on the remote's ordinary screen. Press the centre button below the screen ('Devices'). Expect the screen 'Devices 1/2' with PS3 top left, KPN top right, Kodi bottom left and TV bottom right, and 'Activities' at the bottom. The Flirc hears nothing

Press the right arrow below the screen. Expect 'Devices 2/2' with Denon top left, Panasonic TV top right, Pana bottom left and Knoll bottom right. Pana and Knoll are the two new devices. The Flirc hears nothing

Press the button beside Pana (bottom left). Expect a screen titled 'Pana' with 'Power' top left and 'Back' at the bottom. Press the button beside Power once, briefly. Expect the Flirc to hear the Panasonic power code three times, and nothing else

Press the centre button ('Back') to return to the Devices list (press the right arrow if it shows 1/2), then press the button beside Knoll (bottom right). Expect a screen titled 'Knoll' with 'Power' top left and 'Back' at the bottom. Press the button beside Power once, briefly. Expect the Flirc to hear one 32 bit code about eight times in a row, and nothing else
Press All Off. Expect the Flirc to hear nothing for Pana or Knoll: no activity switched them on, so the remote counts both as off. If the Flirc hears anything, say what with the mark button
